impact.rationale: The add-only measurement workflow uses sudo, Linux namespace and pidfd custody, executes two complete fixed-source Go test legs, and emits evidence that could influence a performance decision. It changes no product Go bytes and has no production path, but a wrong controller could invalidate evidence or mishandle a privileged CI boundary.

regressionLikelihood.rationale: The source-visible contracts are narrow and independently exercised, with no contradicted boundary found. Exact-head Linux namespace, pidfd, Go, filesystem, and hosted-runner behavior has not run, so runtime regression likelihood cannot be rated low.

regressionProtection.rationale: Python AST, 12 positive models, 23 named ValueError-only mutants, real A*/B source-contract replay, exact leg-script checks, immutable Git-object closure, patch identity, and reverse-apply checks passed. Linux execution, Go/gofmt, fresh AB/BA captures, and performance measurement remain unrun.

recoverability.rationale: All four paths are additions on a separate measurement branch. Reverting or deleting the workflow/controller leaves product source and persisted product state unchanged; uploaded diagnostics are measurement-only retained artifacts.

confidence.rationale: Patch identity, callers, source commits, parentage, Go/test byte partitions, normal commands, custody state machine, acceptance split, and model rejection paths were independently traced. The bounded missing evidence is actual Linux execution at the eventual integrated controller commit.

applicability.rationale: The workflow directly calls the added controller and reader for immutable A*=a46f1b93ddec3b600fbe46e906795b84c363f848 and B=b5b5fa96cadbf35ae833c618555ab82e5d70429b on the dedicated measurement branch.

statusQuoRisk.rationale: Without this patch the product remains unchanged; the cost is lack of a controlled same-test source comparison. That is an evidence gap, not a production safety regression.

materialBoundaries.invariant: A* and B must be immutable distinct sources; A* must be the single-parent fd derivative, all 233 test Go files must match, and the sole Go difference must be lifecycle_recovery_store.go.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: A changed test, second Go path, wrong commit, wrong A* parent, dirty checkout, or documentation difference outside chengwang/docs.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: Fixed commit constants plus raw commit-header parent parsing, full ls-tree comparison, all-file source snapshots, exact blob identities, clean worktree checks, and real source-contract replay.

materialBoundaries.invariant: Both legs must run their own byte-identical normal script with default package parallelism and unchanged 180 second, 688-test, 256-entry, and 2 MiB contracts.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: A copied controller script, -p=1, GOMAXPROCS override, changed package order, changed normal script, or changed required-name set.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: Each leg invokes its source run_contracts.sh; source-contract requires script equality and exact commands; sandbox uses fixed env-i without GOMAXPROCS; required names must match the fixed count and digest.

materialBoundaries.invariant: Every leg must execute in a fresh private network/mount/PID namespace with private caches, read-only source/controller/Go root, and a five-event pidfd gate before execution.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: Host namespace reuse within a live leg, writable source or Go root, shared cache, gate release before pidfd acquisition, PID drift, signal-state contradiction, or forged resource rows.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: unshare and mount commands, inner read-only binding record, sandbox-vs-live-host namespace checks, exact five-event reader state machine, exact PID and runner reconciliation, strict resource row types, and 17 relevant isolation/custody mutants among the 23 total.

materialBoundaries.invariant: Preserving originals from a failed or timed-out Go leg must never make that leg or the pair accepted.
materialBoundaries.runtimeRoot: validate_leg, verify, check_pair.main, always-upload workflow step
materialBoundaries.counterexample: A complete-looking report after ordinary/race TLE or nonzero exit is treated as a successful measurement.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: Go acceptance requires zero format/ordinary/race exits plus exact source normal checker acceptance; comparison is written first for diagnosis, then main exits 3 if either goAccepted is false; outer timeout or partial custody cannot satisfy the five-event/receipt/file-set gates.

materialBoundaries.invariant: A captured AB/BA comparison may identify the source change as a possible cause but must not claim equal load, stable benefit, or proven causality.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: A faster single leg is reported as proof that the store change solved the timeout or can replace baseline acceptance.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: Reports hard-code measurementOnly=true, production=false, candidateMayReplaceBaselineAcceptance=false, sameRunnerSameLoadProven=false, and performanceCauseProven=false; both orders and eachGoAccepted are separately reported.
